name: Disabled security service (Defender stop)
kql: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 7036 | where AccountName contains 'WinDefend' or AccountName contains 'wscsvc' | where EventType == 'stopped'
spl: index=windows sourcetype=WinEventLog:System EventCode=7036 (Message=*Windows Defender* OR Message=*Security Center*) (Message=*stopped*)
tuning: No legit reason to stop Defender except maintenance — pair with GPO change audit.
